simulacrum-independent-absorb.head: c2bc37b3
simulacrum-independent-absorb.scope: Two native owned pets. Cast 25 IS/2 s/30 s; durable pet 1087→362 and owner 100→334; L4 pet 224→0 with a single 81 77 and owner 400→500 cap.

damage.source: GOB 607 stores two distinct level-scaled health effects. Their shipped values resolve to 725 neutral pet damage and 234 neutral owner healing at level 27, and 1300/418 at level 50.
damage.runtime: CoderPets.Absorb resolves typed pet life and owner recovery independently, clamps each, and uses ordinary pet death cleanup.
damage.test: CoderPetTests.AbsorbUsesTheIndependentStoredOwnerAndPetHealthEffects and absorb-simulacra-server cover the raw values and both caps. Stock pet 1087→362 and owner 100→334; level-four pet 224→0 and owner 400→500. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/843#issuecomment-7087229822

targeting.source: GOB 607 and AcousticDecoy2_Test require the caster’s live owned Simulacrum as the direct object.
targeting.runtime: CoderPets binds the live owned pet, validates its range and sight at admission and completion, and rejects player, foreign, dead and stale targets.
targeting.test: Stock selected two owned proxies; the replay also rejects empty/foreign and stale live views via the ordinary handler without consuming an effect. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/843#issuecomment-7087229822

script.source: The shipped AcousticDecoy2_Test resolves the owner and pet before the direct-object effect.
script.runtime: CoderPets.TryHealAbility dispatches Absorb on the admitted pet. The pet death branch sends one termination and leaves owner recovery independent.
script.test: The captured-mode and the server replay show the durable pet remains in world, while the lethal cast sends one 81 77 removal and caps the heal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/843#issuecomment-7087229822

source-parity.source: The GOB health payloads differ in recipient, timing direction and damage type. The shipped source functions yield -725 pet HP and +234 caster HP at level 27.
source-parity.runtime: The production effect no longer uses the owner heal as pet damage or bases the heal on available pet health.
source-parity.test: Headless and stock samples demonstrate distinct raw numbers, then independently capped owner/pet effects. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/843#issuecomment-7087229822

behavior-tests.source: GOB 607 requires selected owned pet, 25 IS, 2 s cast and 30 s own reuse before applying its two health records.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler and CoderPets admission, cast and effect paths with CoderPets death publication.
behavior-tests.test: AbsorbUsesTheIndependentStoredOwnerAndPetHealthEffects, native bootstrap ability-parity-absorb-simulacra, and live absorb-simulacra-server plus both stock outcomes. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/843#issuecomment-7087229822
